We need to correctly call verify_step. The tool expects template_id as SMARTS format, not ID. We have the SMARTS string from get_template: 'Br-[C@@H;D3;+0:1](-[C:2])-[C:3]>>[C:2]-[CH2;D2;+0:1]-[C:3]'. That's forward reaction? Actually retro_smarts_template is '[C:2]-[CH2;D2;+0:1]-[C:3]>>Br-[C@@H;D3;+0:1](-[C:2])-[C:3]'. The forward reaction is the reverse: Br-... -> product. The tool verify_step expects template_id (SMARTS) of the forward reaction? It says "template_id (SMARTS format)". So we should provide forward SMARTS: 'Br-[C@@H;D3;+0:1](-[C:2])-[C:3]>>[C:2]-[CH2;D2;+0:1]-[C:3]'.

Let's call verify_step with that.
